tool.name: GlyCombo
tool.description: Identify glycan and polysaccharide compositions from mass spectrometry files
tool.command:
mkdir -p output_dir && /app/GlyComboCLI -F='$input'
## Common monosaccharides (always emitted; CLI defaults are 0) --hexMin '$hex_settings.hexMin' --hexMax '$hex_settings.hexMax' --hexNAcMin '$hex_settings.hexNAcMin' --hexNAcMax '$hex_settings.hexNAcMax' --dHexMin '$hex_settings.dHexMin' --dHexMax '$hex_settings.dHexMax' --hexAMin '$hex_settings.hexAMin' --hexAMax '$hex_settings.hexAMax' --hexNMin '$hex_settings.hexNMin' --hexNMax '$hex_settings.hexNMax' --pentMin '$hex_settings.pentMin' --pentMax '$hex_settings.pentMax'
## Sialic acids (always emitted; CLI defaults are 0) --kdnMin '$sialic_acid_settings.kdnMin' --kdnMax '$sialic_acid_settings.kdnMax' --neu5AcMin '$sialic_acid_settings.neu5AcMin' --neu5AcMax '$sialic_acid_settings.neu5AcMax' --neu5GcMin '$sialic_acid_settings.neu5GcMin' --neu5GcMax '$sialic_acid_settings.neu5GcMax'
## Chemical modifications (always emitted; CLI defaults are 0) --phosMin '$modifications.phosMin' --phosMax '$modifications.phosMax' --sulfMin '$modifications.sulfMin' --sulfMax '$modifications.sulfMax' --dHexNAcMin '$modifications.dHexNAcMin' --dHexNAcMax '$modifications.dHexNAcMax' --acetylMin '$modifications.acetylMin' --acetylMax '$modifications.acetylMax'
## Modified sialic acids (only when enabled) #if str($modified_sialic.enabled) == "yes" --lNeuAcMin '$modified_sialic.lNeuAcMin' --lNeuAcMax '$modified_sialic.lNeuAcMax' --eeNeuAcMin '$modified_sialic.eeNeuAcMin' --eeNeuAcMax '$modified_sialic.eeNeuAcMax' --dNeuAcMin '$modified_sialic.dNeuAcMin' --dNeuAcMax '$modified_sialic.dNeuAcMax' --amNeuAcMin '$modified_sialic.amNeuAcMin' --amNeuAcMax '$modified_sialic.amNeuAcMax' --lNeuGcMin '$modified_sialic.lNeuGcMin' --lNeuGcMax '$modified_sialic.lNeuGcMax' --eeNeuGcMin '$modified_sialic.eeNeuGcMin' --eeNeuGcMax '$modified_sialic.eeNeuGcMax' --dNeuGcMin '$modified_sialic.dNeuGcMin' --dNeuGcMax '$modified_sialic.dNeuGcMax' --amNeuGcMin '$modified_sialic.amNeuGcMin' --amNeuGcMax '$modified_sialic.amNeuGcMax' #end if
## Custom monosaccharides (only when enabled; each slot emitted when its name is set) #if str($custom_mono.enabled) == "yes" #if str($custom_mono.customMono1Name).strip() --customMono1Name '$custom_mono.customMono1Name' --customMono1CCount '$custom_mono.customMono1CCount' --customMono1HCount '$custom_mono.customMono1HCount' --customMono1NCount '$custom_mono.customMono1NCount' --customMono1OCount '$custom_mono.customMono1OCount' --customMono1Mass '$custom_mono.customMono1Mass' --customMono1Min '$custom_mono.customMono1Min' --customMono1Max '$custom_mono.customMono1Max' #end if #if str($custom_mono.customMono2Name).strip() --customMono2Name '$custom_mono.customMono2Name' --customMono2CCount '$custom_mono.customMono2CCount' --customMono2HCount '$custom_mono.customMono2HCount' --customMono2NCount '$custom_mono.customMono2NCount' --customMono2OCount '$custom_mono.customMono2OCount' --customMono2Mass '$custom_mono.customMono2Mass' --customMono2Min '$custom_mono.customMono2Min' --customMono2Max '$custom_mono.customMono2Max' #end if #if str($custom_mono.customMono3Name).strip() --customMono3Name '$custom_mono.customMono3Name' --customMono3CCount '$custom_mono.customMono3CCount' --customMono3HCount '$custom_mono.customMono3HCount' --customMono3NCount '$custom_mono.customMono3NCount' --customMono3OCount '$custom_mono.customMono3OCount' --customMono3Mass '$custom_mono.customMono3Mass' --customMono3Min '$custom_mono.customMono3Min' --customMono3Max '$custom_mono.customMono3Max' #end if #if str($custom_mono.customMono4Name).strip() --customMono4Name '$custom_mono.customMono4Name' --customMono4CCount '$custom_mono.customMono4CCount' --customMono4HCount '$custom_mono.customMono4HCount' --customMono4NCount '$custom_mono.customMono4NCount' --customMono4OCount '$custom_mono.customMono4OCount' --customMono4Mass '$custom_mono.customMono4Mass' --customMono4Min '$custom_mono.customMono4Min' --customMono4Max '$custom_mono.customMono4Max' #end if #if str($custom_mono.customMono5Name).strip() --customMono5Name '$custom_mono.customMono5Name' --customMono5CCount '$custom_mono.customMono5CCount' --customMono5HCount '$custom_mono.customMono5HCount' --customMono5NCount '$custom_mono.customMono5NCount' --customMono5OCount '$custom_mono.customMono5OCount' --customMono5Mass '$custom_mono.customMono5Mass' --customMono5Min '$custom_mono.customMono5Min' --customMono5Max '$custom_mono.customMono5Max' #end if #end if
## Custom reducing end (only when the reducing end format is "custom") #if str($reduced_end.format) == "custom" --customReducingMass '$reduced_end.customReducingMass' --customReducingName '$reduced_end.customReducingName' --customReducedMassOutput '$reduced_end.customReducedMassOutput' --customReducingCCount '$reduced_end.customReducingCCount' --customReducingHCount '$reduced_end.customReducingHCount' --customReducingNCount '$reduced_end.customReducingNCount' --customReducingOCount '$reduced_end.customReducingOCount' #end if
## Custom adduct (only when the adduct type is "Custom") #if str($adduct.type) == "Custom" --customAdductPolarity '$adduct.customAdductPolarity' --customAdductMass '$adduct.customAdductMass' #end if
## General analysis settings --derivatisation '$general_settings.derivatisation' --reducedEnd '$reduced_end.format' --adducts '$adduct.type' --massError '$general_settings.massError' --massErrorType '$general_settings.massErrorType' $general_settings.offByOne $general_settings.noGlyTouCan
--outputPath output_dir/

param.label: Input mass spectrometry data
param.help: Accepts mzML files or text files containing mass lists

param.help: Mass error tolerance value in the units specified by Mass Error Type

param.label: Enable off-by-one searching
param.help: For cases of incorrect monoisotopic precursor determination

param.help: Do not add GlyTouCan base-composition accessions to output files

Maximum ethyl esterified N-acetyl-neuraminic acid (a2,6) count

Maximum ammonia amidated N-acetyl-neuraminic acid (a2,3) count

tool.help:
**What it does**
GlyComboCLI is an open source software for combinatorial glycan composition determination to identify glycans in MS acquisitions of glycan-containing samples in text or mzML formats. It enables rapid extraction of precursor m/z values from mzML files, a vendor-neutral format that ensures cross-platform compatibility.
-----
**Features**
- Analyze mass spectrometry data of glycans and polysaccharides - Support for mzML and text file inputs - Extensive monosaccharide composition search capabilities - Customizable parameters for different types of glycans - Supports various derivatisation methods and reducing end formats - Ability to define custom monosaccharides, reducing ends, and adducts - GlyTouCan base-composition accession annotation for compatible compositions (enabled by default and optionally disabled)
-----
**Input parameters**
The tool offers extensive control over the glycan composition search:
- **Common monosaccharides**: hexose, N-acetyl hexosamine, deoxyhexose, and more - **Sialic acids**: KDN, Neu5Ac, Neu5Gc, and modified variants - **Chemical modifications**: phosphate, sulfate, acetylation - **Custom monosaccharides**: define up to 5 custom monosaccharides - **Reducing end settings**: multiple pre-defined options or custom configurations - **Adduct settings**: various adduct types for positive and negative modes
-----
**Output**
The tool produces a tabular output file listing potential glycan compositions that match the mass spectral data. Compatible compositions include a GlyTouCan base-composition accession unless annotation is disabled. A parameter-summary text file is also produced.
